title: A registered launcher run (--input commit) aborts before cargo when the project's Engram store refuses transiently
outcome: A registered launcher run whose registration meets a transient Engram store refusal (work_projection_invalid or projection_repair_required during a repair) still executes its tests, keeps its evidence locally, and registers or recovers its verification once the store is ready. At minimum the refusal carries a named transient code the launcher can wait on, instead of aborting with an untyped HTTP 502 before any compile.
acceptance: With the project store transiently refusing (typed transient code), a registered run executes, keeps complete local evidence, and later registers exactly once (no duplicate record, unchanged source-identity rules) when the store is ready; or it waits on a named transient code with a bounded, reported wait, never silently aborting as a test failure.
Behavioural tests: a transient refusal followed by a ready store gives exactly one registration with the run's real outcome; a permanent refusal gives a readable named refusal and no credited tests.
The review pair is clean and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.

completion.summary: A registered launcher run whose registration meets a project Engram store in repair (work_projection_invalid or projection_repair_required) no longer aborts with an untyped 502. The host keeps Engram's CLI refusal code (EngramTransportError.refusal_code). The shared classifier engram_store_transient (src/engram_store_transient.rs) recognises those codes. Registration refuses such a held read with a typed 503 code engram_store_transient before recording anything. The launcher prints each wait and resends the unchanged request (10/20/40 s, then 60 s, at most 15 min of pauses); on exhaustion it gives a named refusal. Any other refusal keeps its named 502. Landed as 633cffee (tree bc8f31a7) after DL560 FULL test-e3da59f9 PASS (Rust 8127/0, Vitest 5188/0, Node 563/0, equal sourceIds) and a review pair with no Medium or higher. The independent acceptance evaluation delegation-add5870e passed all 3 criteria. Six unfixed Lows are filed: w-e613153c33f4, w-47eb262f2b88, w-6576b35ccce5.
